path.description: Output file (`.geojson`), relative to the project's exports/.

height.description: Height layer the rivers drain over.

rivers.description: A 0..1 river mask layer to trace (omit for graph splines only).

threshold.description: Mask value from which a cell is river.

min_length_m.description: Reaches shorter than this are dropped, metres.

graph_splines.description: Also write every `jd.terrain.spline@1` node's polyline (roads, canals, dykes).

coordinates.description: Coordinate system of the numbers written.

SplineCoordinates.description: Which numbers a splines export writes.

oneOf.description: Layer metres: `u` east from the west edge, `v` north from the south edge (Blender, engines).
The world's CRS units from its georeference origin (GIS with the same CRS).
WGS 84 longitude / latitude through the world's CRS (standard GeoJSON; needs a CRS).
